name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preselects the sharpest regions to upscale, giving a measurable quality bump without extra compute—exactly the 0.5% lift we need. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in batch processing, but the depth map keeps the upscaler focused where it matters most.

name: Torque
text: InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—it only sharpens existing detail, not regenerate lost facial features. The real risk is wasting 0.5% effort on a tool that doesn’t address the core failure mode. Test RealVisXL v1.1’s face model instead; if it delivers >0.5% gain on benchmark faces, adopt it—else default to SDXL-Lightning for faster, cleaner upscaling.
